title.narrative: Investigating potential for greater youth involvement in partnership with IIMC Youth Council in Kolkata, India

description.narrative: On this Partner Identification trip, three members of IMCC Indien plan to spend eight days in Kolkata, India, where they will explore the possibility of a future partnership with an organised group of young volunteers in the Youth Council of Indian Institute of Mother and Child (IIMC). We believe to be two very like-minded organizations as we have a shared vision of promoting equality, health and education in underprivileged communities. Through local youth involvement this partnership will work towards our common goal to increase access to education amongst the poor population in Kolkata thereby increasing health and equality. During this initial trip IMCC Indien will investigate the role and resources of the IIMC Youth Council to establish the framework for a healthy, equal partnership by exploring our organizations’ compatibility through an honest discussion about our purpose and values, so that we may write a partnership agreement upon our return to Denmark.
